post.description: Update the status of the prescription image a buyer uploaded for an order to approved or rejected, and the reasons.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

prescription_status.description:
The status of the uploaded prescription after review. 
Possible values:
- `APPROVED`: The prescription has been reviewed and is authorized for fulfillment.
- `REJECTED`: The prescription is denied and cannot be fulfilled. The buyer must upload a new prescription. If the prescription is rejected twice, the order will be automatically rejected.
- `PENDING_RESUBMISSION`: The prescription needs corrections or additional information. The buyer must revise and resubmit.

rejection_reason.description:
The reason when you choose to set status `REJECTED`. 
Max length: 5000 characters
Examples of rejection reaon:
- Resep tidak sesuai dengan obat
- Resep tidak ada
- Resep tidak terbaca

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

get.description: Get the list of pharmacies associated with your shop and their corresponding operational details.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results to be returned per page. Default: 50
Valid range: [1, 100]

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the `page_token` parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results.

pharmacies.description: The list of pharmacies that belong to a TikTok Shop.

license_expire_time.description: The license expiration time expressed in Unix timestamp (seconds).

license_number.description: The pharmacy license number, known as Surat Izin Apotek (SIA).

operation_hours.description: A list of operational time ranges for the pharmacy.

close_time.description: The closing time in HH:mm UTC format (24-hour clock).

days.description:
Days of the week when the ePharmacy operates within a specified time range. Possible values: `MON`, `TUE`, `WED`, `THU`, `FRI`, `SAT`, `SUN`

**Note**: Omitted days will be treated as closed days.

pharmacist.description: The pharmacist assigned to the pharmacy.

name.description: The name of the pharmacist, known as Apoteker Penanggung Jawab (APJ).
name.example: Apt. Beatric Siana Dian Kelana, S. Farm

practice_license_expire_time.description: The license expiration time expressed in Unix timestamp (seconds).

practice_license_number.description: The pharmacist practice license number, known as Surat Izin Praktik Apoteker (SIPA).

warehouse_id.description: The ID of the warehouse used for the pharmacy. This is also used as the pharmacy identifier.
